units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 4:1">Ḥull. IV, 1</cite> <he>הוציא הע׳ את ידו</he> if the embryo put forth its forefoot.
<cite ref="Chullin 58a:11">Ib. 58ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ע׳ ירך אמו הוא</he> the embryo is a thigh (part) of its mother, i.e. comes under the same law.
<cite ref="Yevamot 37a:8">Yeb. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>עוּבָּרָהּ ניכר לשליש ימיה</he> her embryo (pregnancy) is felt when she has arrived at the third portion of her days of pregnancy (three months).
Sifré Deut. 29, v. עָבַר Hithpa; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 40a:10">Ab. Zar. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>קירבי דגים ועוּבָּרָן</he>, v. infra.—Pl. <he>עוּבָּרִים</he>, <he>עוּבָּרִין</he>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 57b:2">Snh. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>אף על הע׳</he> the law (<cite ref="Genesis 9:6">Gen. IX, 6</cite>) applies also to killing embryos; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34">Gen. R. s. 34</cite> <he>ע״י ע׳</he> (read: <he>על ע׳</he>).
<cite ref="Chullin 64a:1">Ḥull. 64ᵃ</cite> top; Ab. Zar. l. c. <he>עוּבָּרֵי דגים</he> fish-roe. Ib. <he>קירבי דגים ועוברין</he> (<he>ועוברן</he>) the entrails of fish and their roe.
